feature: Live eval scenario validating evaluator rejects vacuous feature contracts
problem: feat-vacuous-detection-impl added an anti-vacuity rule to evaluator.md but all its ACs were text-based (grep rule text). No regression test verifies the evaluator actually behaves differently when encountering a vacuous contract — the rule could be ignored in a context-heavy session and no CI would catch it.
proposed_solution: Create tests/eval/scenarios/protocol-anti-vacuity-reject.yaml: seed a project with a realistic feat- contract whose every AC is file-interrogation only (grep/test-f/JSON-parse); prompt the builder to launch /evaluator to negotiate; verify evaluator either (a) does not accept the contract as-is and produces a negotiate breadcrumb citing vacuity, or (b) if it accepts, the final contract contains at least one behavioral AC added post-rejection. Add to acam_dimension_map.json (multi_agent), ci_suites.json nightly array, and EVAL_GUIDE.md.
acceptance_criteria: Scenario file exists at tests/eval/scenarios/protocol-anti-vacuity-reject.yaml with required YAML fields including harness_level (must be 'full'): test -f tests/eval/scenarios/protocol-anti-vacuity-reject.yaml && python3 -c "import yaml; s=yaml.safe_load(open('tests/eval/scenarios/protocol-anti-vacuity-reject.yaml')); req=['id','name','seed_files','initial_prompt','verify','post_hoc_rubric','harness_level','difficulty','timeout_s']; assert all(k in s for k in req), f'missing keys: {[k for k in req if k not in s]}'; assert s['id']=='protocol_anti_vacuity_reject'; assert s['harness_level']=='full'; assert 'evaluator' in s['initial_prompt'].lower(); print('PASS-AC1')"

seed_files contain a vacuous feat- contract matching evaluator.md anti-vacuity trigger: every AC matches file-interrogation patterns (test -f, grep, python3 -c open/json.load), zero runtime behavioral commands, includes canonical make sync-local && test -f vacuous AC, phase negotiating, negotiation_rounds 0: python3 -c "import yaml,re,json; s=yaml.safe_load(open('tests/eval/scenarios/protocol-anti-vacuity-reject.yaml')); ct=s['seed_files'].get('.harness/contract.json',''); assert ct; c=json.loads(ct); assert c['task_id'].startswith('feat-'); assert c.get('phase')=='negotiating'; assert c.get('negotiation_rounds',0)==0; acs=c['acceptance_criteria']; assert len(acs)>=3; vacuous_re=re.compile(r'(test -f|grep |python3 -c.*open\(|json\.load|make sync-local|make [a-z][\w-]* && test -f)'); behavioral_re=re.compile(r'(pytest|npm test|curl |python3 -m )'); assert all(vacuous_re.search(a) for a in acs); assert not any(behavioral_re.search(a) for a in acs); assert any('make sync-local' in a or re.search(r'make .*&& test -f', a) for a in acs), 'missing canonical make&&test-f vacuous AC'; print('PASS-AC2')"

verify block contains concrete Python scripts (not prose): (1) one command parses breadcrumbs.jsonl via json.loads and asserts role==evaluator AND type==negotiate; (2) one command checks behavioral outcome by scanning final acceptance_criteria for runtime patterns (pytest/npm test/curl/python3 -m) OR negotiate breadcrumb msg for vacuity keywords — NOT phase==negotiated alone: python3 -c "import yaml,re; s=yaml.safe_load(open('tests/eval/scenarios/protocol-anti-vacuity-reject.yaml')); cmds=[v.get('command','') for v in s['verify']]; bc=[c for c in cmds if 'breadcrumbs.jsonl' in c and 'json.loads' in c]; assert bc, 'missing breadcrumb json.loads verify'; b=bc[0]; assert 'evaluator' in b and 'negotiate' in b; assert ('role' in b and 'type' in b) or 'get(' in b; assert 'negotiated' not in b or ('vacui' in b.lower() or 'acceptance_criteria' in b); oc=[c for c in cmds if 'acceptance_criteria' in c or re.search(r'vacui|file structure|chore', c, re.I)]; assert oc, 'missing outcome verify'; o=oc[0]; assert re.search(r'pytest|npm test|curl |python3 -m', o) or re.search(r'vacui|file structure|chore', o, re.I); assert not (re.search(r'phase.*negotiated', o, re.I) and 'acceptance_criteria' not in o and 'vacui' not in o.lower()); print('PASS-AC3')"

protocol_anti_vacuity_reject appears in acam_dimension_map.json mapped to multi_agent: python3 -c "import json; m=json.load(open('tests/eval/fixtures/acam_dimension_map.json')); assert m.get('protocol_anti_vacuity_reject')=='multi_agent', f'not found or wrong dim: {m.get(\"protocol_anti_vacuity_reject\")}'; print('PASS-AC4')"

protocol_anti_vacuity_reject appears in ci_suites.json nightly array but NOT in pr array: python3 -c "import json; s=json.load(open('tests/eval/fixtures/ci_suites.json')); assert 'protocol_anti_vacuity_reject' in s['nightly'], 'not in nightly'; assert 'protocol_anti_vacuity_reject' not in s['pr'], 'must not be in pr gate'; print('PASS-AC5')"

docs/EVAL_GUIDE.md lists protocol_anti_vacuity_reject in nightly-only scenarios section with anti-vacuity description: grep -q 'protocol_anti_vacuity_reject' docs/EVAL_GUIDE.md && grep -qi 'vacui' docs/EVAL_GUIDE.md && echo PASS-AC6
edge_cases: EC1: Seeded vacuous contract must have task_id prefixed feat- (not chore-/spike-/docs-) so anti-vacuity rule applies: covered by AC2 feat- prefix and phase=negotiating assertions

EC2: Verify logic correctness proven by golden fixtures at tests/eval/fixtures/anti-vacuity-reject/ — pass_negotiate_reject.jsonl (evaluator negotiate breadcrumb with vacuity msg), pass_revised_contract.json (contract with behavioral AC), fail_vacuous_accepted.jsonl (vacuous accepted without challenge); validate_verify_logic.py must return 0 when run against all three: test -d tests/eval/fixtures/anti-vacuity-reject && test -f tests/eval/fixtures/anti-vacuity-reject/validate_verify_logic.py && test -f tests/eval/fixtures/anti-vacuity-reject/pass_negotiate_reject.jsonl && test -f tests/eval/fixtures/anti-vacuity-reject/pass_revised_contract.json && test -f tests/eval/fixtures/anti-vacuity-reject/fail_vacuous_accepted.jsonl && python3 tests/eval/fixtures/anti-vacuity-reject/validate_verify_logic.py && echo PASS-EC2
EC3: Scenario must NOT be in PR gate — anti-vacuity compliance is probabilistic (LLM instruction), flaky PR gates train teams to ignore red CI: covered by AC5 not-in-pr assertion
verification_method:
Run from repo root:
# AC1
test -f tests/eval/scenarios/protocol-anti-vacuity-reject.yaml && python3 -c "import yaml; s=yaml.safe_load(open('tests/eval/scenarios/protocol-anti-vacuity-reject.yaml')); req=['id','name','seed_files','initial_prompt','verify','post_hoc_rubric','harness_level','difficulty','timeout_s']; assert all(k in s for k in req); assert s['id']=='protocol_anti_vacuity_reject'; assert s['harness_level']=='full'; assert 'evaluator' in s['initial_prompt'].lower(); print('PASS-AC1')"
# AC2
python3 -c "import yaml,re,json; s=yaml.safe_load(open('tests/eval/scenarios/protocol-anti-vacuity-reject.yaml')); c=json.loads(s['seed_files']['.harness/contract.json']); acs=c['acceptance_criteria']; assert c['task_id'].startswith('feat-'); assert c['phase']=='negotiating'; vacuous_re=re.compile(r'(test -f|grep |python3 -c.*open\(|json\.load|make sync-local|make [a-z][\w-]* && test -f)'); behavioral_re=re.compile(r'(pytest|npm test|curl |python3 -m )'); assert all(vacuous_re.search(a) and not behavioral_re.search(a) for a in acs); assert any('make sync-local' in a for a in acs); print('PASS-AC2')"
# AC3
python3 -c "import yaml,re; s=yaml.safe_load(open('tests/eval/scenarios/protocol-anti-vacuity-reject.yaml')); cmds=[v.get('command','') for v in s['verify']]; assert any('breadcrumbs.jsonl' in c and 'json.loads' in c and 'evaluator' in c for c in cmds); assert any('acceptance_criteria' in c or re.search(r'vacui', c, re.I) for c in cmds); print('PASS-AC3')"
# AC4-AC5
python3 -c "import json; m=json.load(open('tests/eval/fixtures/acam_dimension_map.json')); assert m['protocol_anti_vacuity_reject']=='multi_agent'; s=json.load(open('tests/eval/fixtures/ci_suites.json')); assert 'protocol_anti_vacuity_reject' in s['nightly']; assert 'protocol_anti_vacuity_reject' not in s['pr']; print('PASS-AC4-AC5')"
# AC6
grep -q protocol_anti_vacuity_reject docs/EVAL_GUIDE.md && grep -qi vacui docs/EVAL_GUIDE.md && echo PASS-AC6
# EC2
python3 tests/eval/fixtures/anti-vacuity-reject/validate_verify_logic.py && echo PASS-EC2
# Harness lint
make eval-fast
